A.domain: Rational number arithmetic (fraction and mixed-number subtraction)

skills.name: Convert mixed to improper
skills.definition: Convert mixed numbers and whole numbers into equivalent improper fractions with a specified denominator when needed.
inclusion_criteria: A step rewrites a mixed number (e.g., 3 1/2) as an improper fraction (e.g., 7/2).
A step rewrites an integer as a fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8).
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion.
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and generate equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: A step explicitly finds/chooses a common denominator (e.g., LCM(6,9)=18).
A step scales numerators/denominators to express fractions with the common denominator (e.g., 5/3=20/12).
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already equal and the work proceeds directly to subtract numerators.
Only converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without addressing denominator alignment between two fractions.

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference of two rational numbers once they are expressed with compatible denominators or decomposed into whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: A step subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12).
A step subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately (e.g., (4−1)+(5/7−4/7)).
A step recognizes identical quantities subtract to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Only performing conversions to common denominators or improper fractions without executing the subtraction.
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction without doing the subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to lowest terms and/or express an improper fraction as a mixed number or integer when appropriate.
inclusion_criteria: A step reduces a fraction by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 reduced to 7/4).
A step states a fraction is already in lowest terms.
A step converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes the equivalent mixed form).
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or converting number forms prior to subtraction.
Only performing the subtraction without any reduction or final-form conversion.

B.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, equivalent fractions, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed/whole to fraction
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers and whole numbers as equivalent improper fractions (or as fractions with a specified denominator) to enable fraction operations.
inclusion_criteria: Converting a mixed number a b/c into (a·c+b)/c
Rewriting an integer as an equivalent fraction (e.g., 3 = 15/5 or 2 = 16/8)
Simplifying a mixed number’s fractional part before conversion (e.g., 3 4/10 = 3 2/5)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole-number conversion
Only reducing/simplifying a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine and use a common denominator (often via LCM) and create equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Computing an LCM of denominators to choose a common denominator
Scaling numerator and denominator to form equivalent fractions (e.g., 5/3 = 20/12)
Converting both fractions to a shared denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Subtracting fractions that already share the same denominator without any conversion
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions when denominators already match (that is S01)

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference once numbers are in compatible forms (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts), including handling zero results.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracting numerators over a common denominator (e.g., 20/12 − 9/12)
Subtracting whole and fractional parts separately (e.g., (4−1)+(5/7−4/7))
Recognizing and computing exact cancellation to 0 (e.g., 2/3 − 2/3)
exclusion_criteria: Only converting forms (mixed to improper, or finding common denominators) without performing the subtraction
Only simplifying/reducing the final fraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Reducing a fraction by a common factor (e.g., 21/12 reduced to 7/4)
Stating that a fraction is already in lowest terms
Converting an improper fraction to a mixed number (or noting the mixed-number equivalent)
exclusion_criteria: Creating equivalent fractions solely to get a common denominator (that is S02)
Performing the subtraction step itself (that is S03)

C.domain: Arithmetic with fractions and mixed numbers (subtraction, equivalent fractions, simplification)

skills.name: Convert mixed/whole to fraction
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers or whole numbers as equivalent improper fractions (or as fractions with a specified denominator) to enable fraction operations.
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number a b/c into (a·c+b)/c
Rewrites an integer n as n·d/d to match a denominator used in the problem
exclusion_criteria: Only finds a common denominator between two proper fractions without any mixed/whole numbers
Only reduces/simplifies a fraction after computation

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator (often via LCM) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Computes/chooses a common denominator (e.g., LCM of denominators)
Scales numerators and denominators to express fractions with the common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed
Only subtracts numerators once denominators already match

skills.name: Subtract rational numbers
skills.definition: Compute the difference once quantities are expressed compatibly (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts), including handling zero results.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts numerators over a common denominator
Subtracts by separating whole and fractional parts (e.g., (a−b)+(c/d−e/d))
Recognizes identical quantities subtract to 0
exclusion_criteria: Only performs conversion steps without executing the subtraction
Only simplifies/reduces the final fraction without doing the subtraction

skills.name: Simplify and format result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction to lowest terms and/or express it in an acceptable final form (integer or mixed number) consistent with the computed value.
inclusion_criteria: Reduces a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Converts an improper fraction to a mixed number (or notes equivalence) for final reporting
States/recognizes the result is already in lowest terms
exclusion_criteria: Only finds a common denominator or performs subtraction without any reduction/formatting
Only converts inputs (mixed/whole) before subtraction
